title: Financial Assistance Percent on Member Appeals to Out-of-Network Plans Paying Second — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — member appeals to an out-of-network plan that pays second.** A patient's award under the **Patient Financial Assistance Program** bears on the member's net exposure on such an appeal. The member's net exposure is the capped charges less the member's residual, times one hundred less the second-plan member appeal's assistance percent, divided by one hundred.

## Clause

The second-plan member appeal's assistance percent is:

- **the discount percent of the patient's approved financial-assistance award**, where that award's window, from its start date through its end date, covers the order's collection date and the award's tier carries a discount percent above zero;
- **50 percent** (the hardship contest percent), where such a covering award carries a discount percent of zero;
- **zero**, otherwise.

The award read is the patient's award whose status is approved. "Covers" includes both ends of the window: a collection date equal to the award's start date or its end date is covered. The collection date is that of the order the appealed claim bills.

## Cases (hypothetical awards)

| Approved award | Window covers the collection date? | Tier discount percent | Assistance percent |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 75 | 75 |
| Yes | Yes | 0 | 50 |
| Yes | No — collection date before the start date | 75 | 0 |
| No approved award | — | — | 0 |

## Hypothetical figure

Capped charges of 400.00 USD less a member's residual of 220.00 USD leave 180.00 USD; with a covering award at a 50 percent discount, the net exposure is 180.00 times 50, divided by one hundred, 90.00 USD.
